book.name: Filemun
book.title: Ŋwa' wvù Baul to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ Filemun

content: Ɛ̀ nu me wvù Baul, ɛ me nu yî ncaw e nje me nu wee Klistu Jisos. Ɛ̀ nu bee waa bwee wesebeene wvù Timatio. Me nsaaŋke ŋwa' wvun fô Filemun wvù nsaa yesebeene shém wvù bee bó lemte yî fiɛɛ le fimwaaŋ,
noo fô Afia wvù jɛme yesebeene le, bô Alkibus wvù beene ɛ bó diuu yî fiɛɛ le fimwaaŋ diɛwɛ bonyii bo jem e, noo fô kentaashɛ ke bonyii bo mbee le kè taashi ɛ̂ wo yew e.
Nyo' Icee wesebeene bô Tata Jisos Klistu ebuw ben bô kembonɛn, ebvuu enya ben bô mvuntelem mvù lɛɛtene.
Ɛ Baul nya keyoone ɛ̂ Nyo' nje Filemun
Filemun, me ŋke ndioo mbunlee sekecii eŋkume wo, no nyaa kɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu keyoone ɛ̂ Nyo' wɛm ɛkumɛ wo,
njefo me n'yuuke no wo nu ɛ lese fitele yî Tata Jisos e, ɛ no kooŋke bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu bo Nyo' le bocii.

Me ɛ no mbunlee lɛ no wo nu ɛ lese wase fitele yî Jisos e, ben ɛ bonyii bo Nyo' le ɛ no nu yî kentaashɛ le, fifin ege ɛ́ wo emɛse ekiɛɛ mwɛɛm mvù jee mvunciim mvù ɛ̀ nu mvusɛɛbeene bò nu ɛ taashɛ bô bo Klistu.
Waa bwɛɛm, kfuu keŋkoŋɛn kè wo kɛŋke fô bonyii bo Nyo' le, gee ɛ mvuntelem mvubole lɛɛtene, nu ɛ ge me ɛ no n'yuuke njoŋ baay, ɛ fitele fiem tɛn yvuwse.
Ɛ Baul lɛkɛ Filemun ɛkumɛ Onesimus
Fiɛɛ fimew ɛ mum ɛ no nu dvú fì me nshieele lɛ wo ege, ɛ ɛ̀ be nulo ɛ́ me eŋgay lo bô mvuŋgay mvù me ŋkɛŋke diɛwɛ wee Klistu le lɛ wo ege.
Geenɛn, nje keŋkoŋɛn, me nu eŋku lo can ɛ̂ wo. Me wvù Baul nu wase ŋgaywee, ɛ me mbvuu nu yî ncaw e keseen nje saaka wvu ɛkumɛ Klistu Jisos.
Me ɛ no ŋkule can ɛ̂ wo ɛkumɛ waa wɛm wvù Onesimus wvun. Me nto njo wvú waa wɛm e yî mbee le nu yew ncaw e fɛn.
Fwele to nu ɛ wvú nu fiɛɛ fi ɛcici fô wo le. Keseen wvú ɛ no looci wase nu naa wee fô bee wo le bocii.
Me ɛ no ntfuuse wvú jim fô wo le keseen. Wvú looci nu fitele fiem.
Me ŋkooŋke lɛ ɛ̀ be nulo ɛ́ me eŋgɛɛ wvú mbew yɛm e ɛ́ wvú etaale fô me le fô bvudvuu bwuw e no me nu yî ncaw e fɛn nje saaka wvù jee wvu ɛkumɛ Jisos.

Geenɛn, me ɛ n'yɛn lɛ kɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ me eŋge fiɛɛ diɛwɛ fifin e sɛ wo kee fó kɛ, njefo kɛ me ŋgomte lɛ lemme diuw dì jee dì wo gee fô me le enù kɛ diɛwɛ me ŋkane lo wo kɛ. Me ŋgomte lɛ fí enù no fitele fiuw nu ɛ bee.
Sekemew ɛ Onesimus to nɛ ɛ̂ wo ɛjise yî kefew e caan nɛn, lɛ wvú ke dioo ɛ tu jim, ɛ́ ben ɛ wvú emum enù wase kemakaa,
ɛ wvú yaa bvuu nu nfwa kɛ, ɛ wvú fele wase nfwa. Wvú nu wase waa bwoo shém yî Klistu le, ɛ wvú nu tɛn fô me le baay sɛ ge fô wo le, no wvú nu wee wo lemme bvuu nu wee Tata.
Nonɛn, ɛ́ wo fɛn nu ɛ yɛn lɛ bee wo nu yî kentaashɛ le, ɛ́ wo fiisɛn wvú no ɛ̀ be nu me ɛ́ wo efiisɛn.
Ɛ́ ɛ̀ nu lɛ wvú to nu ɛ jay fiɛɛ fô wo le, kɛnɛɛ lɛ, wvú kɛŋke fioo ben ɛ wvú, ɛ́ wo gɛɛ ɛ̂ diee diem e.
Me nsaaŋke fin ɛ ɛ̀ nu bô kebo kem lɛ, “Me wvù Baul nu ŋke enlaw.” Me njemyi nɛn ɛ kɛ shiee nu dvú wvù me nshe nseŋe lo lɛ, wo tɛn kɛŋke fioo bee wo kɛ. Nshii wvù wo kɛŋke keseen nu nje me.
Nonɛn waa bwɛɛm, ficɛ kɛ me njefo bee wo nu bonyii bo Tata le. Geɛ nonɛn nje kentaashɛ ke bee wo le yî Klistu le ɛ́ ye ejoŋ me.
Me nsaaŋke ɛ̂ wo nɛn, ŋkee naa ntay lɛ wo nu ebee keege fiɛɛ fì me ŋgayte, ɛ wo nu dioo gee, ege naa efesɛn lo.
Keebvuu bise fó, seyse bvudvuu bvu nce le ɛ̂ me, njefo me ntaale fwe ŋkee lɛ Nyo' nu eyuw bunle yene eciinse me fô ben e.
Ŋgayma
Ɛbaflas wvù nu bee bó yî ncaw e fɛn nje saaka wvu ɛkumɛ Klistu Jisos, gayte wo le.
Maaku, Alistakus, Dɛmas noo Luk bò bee bó lemte yî kentaashɛ le, gayte tɛn wo le.
Tata Jisos Klistu ebuw ben bô kembonɛn kew ɛ́ kí eficì biyoy binɛn.
